turns.speaker: AGENT

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.text: Margaret Hughes, 8 October 1964.

turns.text: Thank you, Margaret, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've moved house and need your address updated. Is that right?

turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And what's the new address, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 22 Maple Close.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is my premium going to stay the same?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. The change takes effect straight away, your premium may be recalculated, and we'll send your updated policy documents within 3 working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Margaret. I've updated your address under reference REQ-54271, and our policy services team will send the new documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've updated your address on the policy.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER

turns.speaker: AGENT
